SASBDB entry SASDVU5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDVU5/)

Publication: The structure and function of the DNA binding domain of class B MpARF2 share more traits with class A AtARF5 than to that of class B AtARF1.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.str.2025.02.006

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDVU5/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
